title: kate-core: choose a reload prompt from the disk change
summary: reload_choice reads FileState::disk_change and the dirty flag. A clean modified file reloads. A dirty buffer asks. No disk change stays quiet. Linux CI runs the test.

lane.reason: The work is pure Rust in kate-core. Linux CI runs the test. It does not watch the disk and it does not draw a sheet.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Add ReloadChoice and FileState::reload_choice. disk_change None returns Quiet. Modified or Created with dirty false returns Reload. Modified or Created with dirty true returns Ask. Deleted returns Ask for both dirty flags. Leave note_disk and from_loaded unchanged. The existing note_disk test stays green. Leave workspace.rs unchanged. This packet does not watch the disk and it does not draw a sheet. Leave layout.rs and notice.rs unchanged. PKT-0069 owns those files. Leave paint.rs unchanged. PKT-0071 owns that file. Leave fold.rs and view.rs unchanged. PKT-0073 owns those files. Leave command.rs and workspace.rs unchanged. PKT-0074 owns those files. regression_tests.name: document::tests::reload_choice_asks_when_the_buffer_is_dirty
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because reload_choice does not exist. A cleared disk change returns Quiet. Modified and Created return Reload when the buffer is clean. They return Ask when the buffer is dirty. Deleted returns Ask when the buffer is clean and when it is dirty.
